title: A Structural Theory of Cognitive Representation and Problem Solving,Contexts, Invariance, and the Knowledge Space
abstract: arXiv:2610.12306v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning and problem solving depend critically on the structure of internal representations. While many modern data-driven artificial systems achieve strong predictive performance, their learned representations often lack explicit structure for expressing abstraction, invariance, and task-relevant regularities. We propose a minimal structural framework in which representational operations relevant to problem solving, such as context formation, invariance recognition, representative selection, abstraction, and procedural reuse, are made explicit. The central notion is that of a \emph{context}, formalized as a partition of a subset of an underlying state space, which fixes the distinctions, granularity, and form in which a problem can be posed. translated_title: 认知表征与问题解决的结构性理论：语境、不变性与知识空间
translated_abstract: 学习与问题解决在关键程度上依赖于内部表征的结构。尽管许多现代数据驱动的人工系统取得了强大的预测性能，但它们学习到的表征往往缺乏用于表达抽象、不变性和任务相关规律性的显式结构。我们提出了一个最小化的结构框架，将与问题解决相关的表征操作——如语境形成、不变性识别、代表性选择、抽象和程序复用——加以显式化。其中的核心概念是“语境”，它被形式化为底层状态空间某一子集上的一个划分，该划分确定了问题得以表述时的区分方式、粒度和形式。在这一设定下，不变性识别与代表性选择被视为基本的表征操作。该框架被实现为由两个相互耦合的部分构成的知识空间。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个关于认知表征与问题解决的最小结构化框架，将“语境”形式化为状态空间的划分，并以此构建知识空间，使抽象、不变性识别与程序复用等关键表征操作得以显式表达。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a minimal structural framework for cognitive representation and problem solving, formalizing "contexts" as partitions of an underlying state space and realizing it as a Knowledge Space that makes abstraction, invariance recognition, and procedural reuse explicit.
